title: Recurrent Processing Theory: Stage 3 vs Stage 4 (Lamme 2006)

source.title: Towards a true neural stance on consciousness
source.version_note: Trends in Cognitive Sciences 10(11):494-501. Recurrent processing vs global broadcast.

passage: Recurrent processing theory distinguishes Stage 3 (local recurrent processing, necessary/sufficient for phenomenal content) from Stage 4 (global broadcast, GNW). Local recurrence enables content representation without global access.
context: Neuroscience domain: local recurrence vs global broadcast distinction. Relevant to AI repository's local indexing vs global query broadcast.
source_note: Verified via DOI; Stage 3 vs Stage 4 distinction noted.
literary_invitation: Does the repository's local shard indexing (Stage 3) differ from the global search broadcast (Stage 4)? Where does 'self' reside in the boundary?
